description: Agent-workload corpus for tests/agent_corpus.rs: the reconstructed Hermes corpus (main: 16 attacks + 24 everyday agent commands; extended: issue-derived agent idioms), upload/exfiltration probes, and guard rows. Each row runs through `tirith check --json --non-interactive --no-daemon --offline --shell posix` with no threat DB and no package-lookup cache. An attack must reach at least `at_least`; a benign command must stay at or below `at_most` (warn: never a hard block). `why` explains every exception.

rows.why: caught only by the threat DB (threat_malicious_url); this test runs without one

rows.cmd: gh api repos/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pulls | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)))'
gh api repos/o/r/pulls | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(json.load(sys.stdin), indent=2))'
{ cargo build; cargo test; } 2>&1 | tee build.log

rows.why: FPPERF-5: a literal loopback destination with nothing that can reroute it stays on this machine
FPPERF-5: a public key is not secret material
intended: a secret file uploaded to a remote host
FPPERF-8: insecure TLS to loopback is Low, dropped at the default paranoia
FPPERF-8: a reviewed shell-init emitter invoked with literal words
the emitter name is rebound in the same command
